chapter: Drum sets and New Orleans drummers
title: Early New Orleans drummers: Cantrell, Henry Zeno and others
summary: Hall talks about older New Orleans drummers including Cantrell and Henry Zeno and where they played.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Of the New Orleans drummers, do you remember any of the early ones like old man Contrell or Contrell?
He was mostly, he used to play at the Lyric Theater all the time.
Oh, the John Robeshow? Yeah. And the band.
That's right, yeah. Him and, well, the drummers in the Orleans in those days, I did like Henry Zeno.
Yeah. He was a pretty fast drummer in those days.
Remember which band he played with? Henry? He mostly worked nightclubs.
You know, the clubs down next to when the district was over.
Yeah, that's right. That's my first band, Henry Zeno. Well, I guess he worked with Oliver there.
I'd known he worked uptown, I think, with the Eagle Band, Frankie Doosen up at St. Mastonic Hall. I didn't know if you heard him up there.
